when: Closed test for the GFAL community Nov 26 · Open Beta Nov 28, 2026
how_to_join: Download from Google Play / App Store on Nov 28. Search for WWII: TCG and check the developer is Games for a Living
token: No token yet. Some cards will be tradable on the GFAL Marketplace later
warn: Playable without connecting a wallet. Watch out for fake apps with similar names in the store; check the developer name before downloading

when: Android beta open since Nov 3, 2026 · no date yet for iOS or PC
how_to_join: Free download from Google Play via the link on the official website. A 10-player arena fighting game with one winner
token: No token yet. There is in-game currency, but no word on whether it will be a token
warn: Spectators can bet on players, which counts as gambling. Don't put in real money, and the new chain still has few users

when: Early Access and Open Beta on Steam since Oct 22, 2026
how_to_join: Free download on Steam, playable right away without a wallet. The Web3 version opens separately
warn: Few players so far. You don't need to buy KATA to start playing. Watch out for fake sites offering to claim KATA

when: Next test round focuses on PC, date not announced yet (every past round required an invite code)
how_to_join: Preregister with Sky Mavis, then follow Axie's official X and Discord for invite codes
warn: A large, credible team, but never buy "invite codes" from strangers. Codes are only given out free through official channels

when: Closed test (about 500 players), no launch date yet

cost: Test not specified · land sold out

when: Played in rounds (Cycles) with free trial periods from time to time. Latest update: Digital Chemistry
how_to_join: Sign up on the official website, then wait for a free trial period or buy Founder Access
cost: Free rounds now and then; normally you have to buy access
